reading.zh: 自上而下：面板本体（动作清单 → 每项一个按钮）→ 按键注入（点一下怎么变成 EFMI 轮询真的读到的“按下”）→ 把这两层在不开游戏的情况下钉住的离线自测。
reading.en: Top to bottom: the panel itself (action list → one button per entry) → the key injection (how a click becomes a "key down" that EFMI's polling actually sees) → the offline self-test that pins both layers without launching the game.
